svg.title: COSTGRAD: select once per planning step, then search actions on a fixed token subset
svg.desc: Visual pathway. Full-grid zero-action probe and planning-cost gradients select spatial positions. The same positions gather context and goal features. A compact strip shows sparse CEM action search on this fixed subset, followed by execution of the first action. The predictor and encoders stay frozen. Reselect at the next observation. Wall frames are illustrative examples from the supplied diagram; all token grids are schematic.
svg.text: (a) COSTGRAD: select once per planning step
Same subset across candidates and iterations
